name: Pricol Ltd
title: Pricol Ltd - 540293 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue INR 1,077.9 cr (EBITDA 13.29%) but management flags West Asia-driven input inflation and softer earnings ahead; FY27 capex INR 680-700 cr signals capacity expansion into a soft cycle.

utilisation.quote: our capacity utilization has reached a peak. In fact, so much so that in plastics, we are unable to grow this year because of lack of capacity

capex.quote: this year, in itself, we have planned for about between INR 680 crore to INR 700 crores of CAPEX to cater to all of our new businesses

triggers.label: FY27 capex INR 680-700 cr
triggers.quote: we have planned for about between INR 680 crore to INR 700 crores of CAPEX
triggers.highlight: INR 680 crore to INR 700 crores of CAPEX

triggers.label: Input costs up sharply, recovery partial
triggers.quote: If you ask me can we recover the entire amount from the OEM, I do not think so.

triggers.label: Earnings softening flagged
triggers.quote: there will be some softening of earnings and slowing of the whole automotive sector

triggers.label: P3L margin to fall to ~10%
triggers.quote: So, we will go back to normalized margins of 10% or so
triggers.highlight: go back to normalized margins of 10%

guidance.value: Continue to grow above market growth rate
guidance.quote: we will be continuing to grow at higher than the market growth rate
I am not sure we will be able to meet those numbers

guidance.value: Double turnover in three years, on track
guidance.quote: we are well on track to double P3L's business or probably even exceed in the three- year timeframe
we will have a debt-equity ratio of probably about 0.5 or 0.6, not even hitting 1

guidance.value: Held at 200% for FY26, review after H1
guidance.quote: retain it at a 200% dividend for the FY26, see the performance for the next six months
our goal is to take it to 10% of revenue in the coming years

prior_guidance_check.quote: we had a guidance of 13% to 15% growth for Pricol
I am happy to note we have hit that mark, but with next to no debt
that is one area where we failed to deliver
Under normal conditions, we should have hit a 30% growth rate
we are well on track to double P3L's business

red_flags.label: Dividend held despite higher payout capacity
red_flags.quote: we believed that, having already declared an interim Golden Jubilee dividend of 200%, we felt it was good to conserve cash

red_flags.label: Competitor entering instrument clusters
red_flags.quote: there is a group company which is entering the instrument cluster business

red_flags.label: Restatement of borrowings in FY25
red_flags.quote: debt-like items to be regrouped, which the customer bill discounting and vendor bill discounting

evasions.quote: Frankly, I think we should ask this question to Mr. Donald Trump on a lighter note
time will tell. But I think, next quarter, we will have a better idea
It's very difficult to answer that question, Mr. Nahar
